stage0053_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
Researcher
「Same as Case 3.
　All the city's residents have symptoms.」

stage0053_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$トライア$$
「So they're 50% behind absolute time...
　I thought the delay rate was 2.2%...」

stage0053_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
Researcher
「Yes.
　The time delay for $$バルエヨルズル$$'s
　citizens is off the charts.」

stage0053_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$トライア$$
「Just like Case 1's Limonesia and Case 2's
　Audis, this city's people are already
　feeling the Prison of Time's effects...」

stage0053_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$トライア$$
（So it's the same as that kid...）

stage0053_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$トライア$$
「...It's probably the dimensional distortion.」

stage0053_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$トライア$$
「A few factors overlapped, so this city
　is likely feeling the $$新世時空震動$$'s effects」

stage0053_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$トライア$$
「So there's a gap in how time passes for us
　versus them, and that's why we get this」

stage0053_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
Researcher
「I can't believe that could happen...」

stage0053_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$トライア$$
「The locals wouldn't notice anything odd
　among themselves, but to us unaffected
　ones, they must look like we move at warp speed...」

stage0053_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$トライア$$
「And if we stay in this area too long,
　we'll end up affected too」

stage0053_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
???
「...That's right.
　But no need to worry, though」

stage0053_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「In three months, everyone in the world
　gets cut off from absolute time for good anyway」

stage0053_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$トライア$$
「...So you're $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$?」

stage0053_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Sharp, lady.
　No surprise, from the foremost authority
　in hyperspace physics, Dr. $$トライア・スコート$$」

stage0053_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Came to check how the dimensional cage
　turned out, and ran into someone fun」

stage0053_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$トライア$$
「...Here to finish me off, since I'm in your plan's way?」

stage0053_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hahahaha!
　Now that's a good one!」

stage0053_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Don't get cocky, lady.
　However hard you struggle, you lot can't
　break the Prison of Time. No way」

stage0053_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Sorry, but I've got somewhere to be too.
　I'll say my goodbyes here」

stage0053_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「See ya, Doctor.
　Good luck with all that」

stage0053_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$トライア$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...」

stage0053_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$トライア$$
「I'll make him regret looking down on me...
　on all of humanity.」

stage0053_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$リディ$$
「...What are you up to, $$バナージ$$?
　Meeting with the volunteer club about ship cleanup?」

stage0053_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アルト$$
「For the record, it's not like we're
　always out here picking up trash」

stage0053_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$リディ$$
「Joking, just joking.
　Sorry if that rubbed you wrong」

stage0053_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$リディ$$
「So, what's this meeting about, anyway?」

stage0053_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$オードリー$$
「It's about Miss $$スズネ$$」

stage0053_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$カツ$$
「Haven't you noticed?
　Miss $$スズネ$$'s been acting strange lately...」

stage0053_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Yesterday she crashed the drinking party
　with $$ミサト$$, $$スメラギ$$ and $$マオ$$, and went wild」

stage0053_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$エマ$$
「Just joining that group in the first place
　is already strange enough」

stage0053_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Plenty of others have witnessed her acting
　more roughly than ever before, too」

stage0053_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$リディ$$
「Hard to imagine...
　Miss $$スズネ$$, of all people...」

stage0053_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Isn't it that Miss $$スズネ$$ finally got
　fed up with your spineless behavior?」

stage0053_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Come on, you two, cut it out.
　It's because they don't know that $n
　came to us for advice」

stage0053_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You're closer to her age, any idea, Ensign $$リディ$$?」

stage0053_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$リディ$$
「She's riding in the $$ジェニオン$$ with you
　out of a sense of responsibility.
　In other words, she's not fighting by choice」

stage0053_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$エマ$$
「Even without that, there's been a lot
　of shocking stuff lately, starting with
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$...」

stage0053_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$リディ$$
「That stress might be pushing her to the edge」

stage0053_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Who cares about stress!
　Liiisten to my song!!」

stage0053_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Yeah, figured it'd come to this...」

stage0053_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Once he shows up, there's no talking sense.」

stage0053_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Don't get so worked up, my friend.
　Open your heart to his passionate melody
　and try setting yourself free」

stage0053_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$シンジ$$
「No... I just thought... that's surprising...」

stage0053_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$シュレード$$
「That I'm fond of Fire Bomber's
　melodies?」

stage0053_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Wouldn't that sound like noise to a classical
　player like you?」

stage0053_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Form means nothing before the sound itself.
　Just surrender honestly to the melody as it is」

stage0053_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Maybe if you honestly accept Miss $$スズネ$$'s
　change too, it'll turn out to be nothing」

stage0053_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$シュレード$$
「In short, who she is right now
　is her true self」

stage0053_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Objection! Big objection!
　Miss $$スズネ$$'s our Madonna!」

stage0053_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$n... looks like quite a shock, huh...」

stage0053_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$宗介$$
「Buck up, $n.
　$$ヒイロ$$ said not to fear change, too」

stage0053_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Think about your timing for that line!」

stage0053_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$n
（Before even worrying about her true self,
　I... don't know anything about Miss $$スズネ$$ at all...）

stage0053_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「That's enough, $$バサラ$$!
　Think about $n's feelings too!」

stage0053_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Oh, right, $n...
　Did you hear the analysis on that frozen robot?」

stage0053_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
（Way to go, $$ガムリン$$!
　Nice topic change!）

stage0053_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アルト$$
（Seriously, he's got it together.
　Can't imagine supporting $$バサラ$$
　without that kind of patience）

stage0053_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「That robot's got heavy damage all over,
　so it likely went through quite a battle」

stage0053_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$カツ$$
「A 200-meter giant robot's fierce battle, huh...」

stage0053_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「What happened to the girl piloting it?」

stage0053_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「She's still unconscious, from what I hear.
　If she wakes up, we might learn a bit
　about where that robot came from」

stage0053_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$リディ$$
「Wonder how much fighting she's been through at that age...」

stage0053_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$c's heading back to Earth
　to report on the $$インベーダー#keyword$$ matter」

stage0053_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Once she gets treated at a proper
　medical facility, she'll wake up eventually」

stage0053_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$アルト$$
「What we need to think about now
　is $$エタニティ・フラット$$ and $$バアル$$...」

stage0053_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$かなめ$$
（$$エタニティ・フラット$$... the Prison of Time...
　A limited rewrite of law within an isolated dimension...）

stage0053_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$かなめ$$
（This too is a product of the $$時空震動$$...
　If so, there's only one way
　to reset it...）

stage0053_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$かなめ$$
（But without knowing what makes up this world,
　pinning down the multiverse's origin is impossible...）

stage0053_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Eh... ah...?
　Guess I zoned out for a second」

stage0053_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$オードリー$$
「There's also the matter of Miss $$スズネ$$.
　Please take care of yourself too, $$かなめ$$」

stage0053_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Er, everyone... sorry to interrupt
　your relaxation, but a Neo Zeon force
　has been spotted on $c's course」

stage0053_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$田中司令$$
「We've kept a policy of staying out of
　the war with Neo Zeon,
　but that's on our end...」

stage0053_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$田中司令$$
「From their side, it seems they can't
　leave a Federation officer like $c alone.
　Ah well... tough being popular」

stage0053_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$リディ$$
「Is now really the time to be so laid-back!」

stage0053_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「If they're coming at us, we fight back...!
　Everyone, let's go!」

stage0053_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$バサラ$$
「War's such a waste of time...」

stage0053_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Geez!
　Say that to Captain $$クワトロ$$!」

stage0053_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's been a while, $$カレン$$.
　Even I've heard tell of $c's feats」

stage0053_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$デュオ$$
「So you two have been chasing Geminis
　all this time, huh」

stage0053_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$スザク$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$ asked us to」

stage0053_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$スザク$$ and I once sheltered with
　Neo Zeon. There, he had us investigate
　Geminis, the foe then called UG」

stage0053_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Just as you suspected, Captain $$アムロ$$.
　I wanted to confirm $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s true intent」

stage0053_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll be blunt with you as well.
　With firm resolve and determination,
　he now calls himself Neo Zeon's Supreme Commander」

stage0053_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Unfortunately, words from someone
　like me couldn't shake that resolve」

stage0053_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$スザク$$
「What we must do is already decided」

stage0053_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If $$シャア・アズナブル$$ wants to fight,
　stopping him is $$スザク$$'s and my duty」

stage0053_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes... the same as you and $c」

stage0053_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$ゼロ$$, $$スザク$$... welcome aboard」

stage0053_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$スザク$$
「Good to be working with you again」

stage0053_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But the situation is tougher than ever」

stage0053_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$... and $$バアル$$, is it...」

stage0053_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Allow me to introduce her properly.
　$$ガンバスター$$'s pilot, $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$」

stage0053_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$.
　Pleased to be working with you」

stage0053_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$カレン$$
「'Pleased to be working with you'...」

stage0053_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「As of today, she's a member of $c too」

stage0053_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Is that really okay...!
　Deciding that easily!」

stage0053_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Coming here via a $$時空震動$$ means
　you're from another world, right?」

stage0053_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's fine.
　This is what I wanted」

stage0053_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I trust my own intuition.
　Even if this is a different world,
　I believe you protect Earth, same as me」

stage0053_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$オズマ$$
「So you really came from a world unlike ours...」

stage0053_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Going by what she says, that's a fair guess」

stage0053_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And apparently, their world
　was under assault by those space beasts」

stage0053_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「It was a long, hard fight...」

stage0053_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「But we fought on, centered on $$ガンバスター$$,
　and carried out a final operation to
　destroy the beast nest at the galaxy's core」

stage0053_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「That operation succeeded, but the
　$$ガンバスター$$ Big Sis and I were riding
　was swallowed by a black hole at the end」

stage0053_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Someone who piloted $$ガンバスター$$
　together with me. She's precious to me」

stage0053_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「It seems we got separated
　when we came to this world, though...」

stage0053_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$竜馬$$
「And you got spat out of that black hole
　and thrown into this world, huh」

stage0053_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「My $$ガンバスター$$ is a Buster Machine
　developed to fight the space beasts」

stage0053_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「The data stored inside it should
　prove useful in this world too」

stage0053_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「《$$ＳＴＭＣ$$》... commonly called space beasts,
　exist to destroy human civilization...
　In short, they're humanity's natural enemy」

stage0053_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Much about their biology's unknown,
　but it's been kill or be killed between
　us, with both species' survival at stake」

stage0053_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$隼人$$
「Humanity's natural enemy...
　So that's $$バアル$$, then」

stage0053_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Kill or be killed, huh...
　Same as with the $$インベーダー#keyword$$」

stage0053_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Whether the space beast we fought
　today is a survivor of our world,
　or something born in this one, I don't know」

stage0053_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「But since one appeared like that,
　I think it's likely more will target Earth」

stage0053_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「First the $$インベーダー#keyword$$, now stuff
　like that shows up too...
　Just thinking about it's depressing」

stage0053_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$宗介$$
「It concerns the $$ジェニオン$$ you wanted,
　and $$ガドライト$$'s $$ジェミニア$$」

stage0053_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$n
「Even if $$ジェニオン$$ is an imitation
　of his machine, my fight doesn't change」

stage0053_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アルト$$
「Your fight isn't just yours anymore」

stage0053_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ and Geminis are
　enemies of us all, of the whole world」

stage0053_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I don't fully get it, but if they're
　everyone's enemy, they're mine too」

stage0053_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$n
「Thanks, Ms. Takaya.
　We won because of you」

stage0053_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「We're close in age, just call me $$ノリコ$$.
　We're comrades from today, after all」

stage0053_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$シモン$$
「New enemies, new comrades...
　Despair came, but so did hope」

stage0053_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$竜馬$$
「My mind's made up.
　All we can do now is move forward」

stage0053_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$スザク$$
「$c...
　They'll become the world's hope, won't they」

stage0053_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「We'll fight as part of that too」

stage0053_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$ゼロ$$...
　After you split from us, did you
　and $$スザク$$ chase Geminis on your own?」

stage0053_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$スザク$$
「We were looking into who's behind Geminis」

stage0053_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Not only that.
　On Earth, besides Amalgam,
　they have other collaborators too」

stage0053_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$スザク$$
「We only know their name so far, but...」

stage0053_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's... those $$アドヴェント$$ people, isn't it...!」

stage0053_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$アルト$$
「So $$アドヴェント$$'s... a Geminis collaborator...」

stage0053_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$甲児$$
「Then that guy...
　was deceiving us after all!」

stage0053_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$n
「...I don't think that man
　was lying to us...」

stage0053_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's leave it there.
　This is too heavy an issue for guesswork」

stage0053_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$n
「Geminis and Chrono...
　$$ガドライト$$ and $$アドヴェント$$...
　just what connects them all...」

stage0053_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Hey... $$ジェニオン$$...
　We go back a fair while, you and I,
　but I never understood you at all...」

stage0053_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just what's your connection
　to that $$ジェミニア$$ unit...」

stage0053_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wh, why, $n...!
　You've seen me at my most pathetic」

stage0053_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$n
「We've got nothing but $$ジェニオン$$.
　And unless we beat that $$ジェミニア$$,
　it'll keep being called an imitation」

stage0053_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$n
「Let's do this, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I will beat him with $$ジェニオン$$...
　$$ガドライト$$ and his $$ジェミニア$$, for sure」

stage0053_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood, $n.
　Naturally, as a $$ＤＥＭ$$ agent, I too
　will support you with all I have」

stage0053_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Luckily, today's battle let us work out
　the conditions for activating $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$」

stage0053_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「From now on, I'll display information
　whenever activation becomes possible」
